evidence: In the heart of the sacred Phủ Tây Hồ, a peninsula jutting out into the windy lake, the Golden Buffalo Sacred Bell stands as an enduring cultural symbol of the capital city. This majestic bronze bell, with its cylindrical structure tapering toward the top, exudes an ancient and solemn beauty, its deep gray hue a testament to the passage of time.

In the heart of the sacred Phủ Tây Hồ, a peninsula jutting out into the windy lake, the Golden Buffalo Sacred Bell stands as an enduring cultural symbol of the capital city. This majestic bronze bell, with its cylindrical structure tapering toward the top, exudes an ancient and solemn beauty, its deep gray hue a testament to the passage of time.

The bell's surroundings are equally impressive, with meticulously pruned bonsai canopies and lush green potted plants opening up to a breezy space right next to the vast waters of West Lake. The entire scene is a testament to the harmonious blend of nature and culture, as the ancient and the modern coexist in perfect balance.
